claude.note: Claude Code headless mode. Prompt goes on stdin. {output} = json (quiet) or stream-json (live agent activity in the terminal). Role tools -> --allowedTools; charter forbiddenPaths/forbiddenTools -> --disallowedTools. CLAUDE.md @imports profile.md + lessons.md, so the harness does not inject those twice (except in worktrees).

antigravity.note: UNVERIFIED (confirm with 'agy --help'). The Antigravity terminal agent is 'agy'; '-p ""' runs headless with the prompt piped on stdin (avoids argument length limits and Windows newline quoting). Unconfirmed that agy appends stdin to an empty -p; if not, set promptVia to 'arg' and args to ['-p','{prompt}']. No auto-approve flag on purpose (the owner approved auto-approve for Gemini only).

orca.note: UNVERIFIED: flags from the original spec. Doctor probes 'orca run --help'; falls back to 'auto' if a flag is missing. Prompt goes on stdin.

gemini.note: UNVERIFIED (confirm with 'gemini --help'). Headless: '-p' with the prompt piped on stdin (stdin is appended to the -p text). '--approval-mode yolo' (replaces the deprecated --yolo) auto-approves every tool; the owner approved this for this project.
